report: Independent cross-chunk lemma consistency review: complete Al-Muminun draft
status: No required lemma field changes found
scholarlyReview: Pending. This AI consistency review does not grant publication approval.
assemblyScopeNote: The review began on imported chunks while the final chunk and assembly were pending. All33chunks were present before completion; the newly emitted held Surah23 draft was then compared against the entire authored ID/lemma sequence. No partial review is represented as complete.
method: Read each of1,050 authored lemma fields with its exact source occurrence Arabic, fixed word class and root.
Reviewed repeated-context and source-group variants without forcing one spelling onto valid citation, tanwin, gender or fused forms.

Checked every verb against the effective lexeme and voice after adjudicated overrides. Passive occurrences are checked for active dictionary citations, not forced to match passive paradigm past forms.
Used NFC only as a comparison operation for combining-mark order. No word occurrence or lemma was normalized or edited.
After all33chunks were imported, verified full planned ID coverage and exact authored-versus-emitted ID/lemma sequence, plus unchanged occurrence Arabic against source metadata.

manuallyConfirmedWithoutMatchingActKey.decision: Correct active dictionary citation. The passive card noteUrdu and evidenceEnglish explicitly supply سَحَرَ / يَسْحَرُ; no matching ACT-key entry is required to establish this citation.

diagnosticDispositions.decision: The same verbs and particle/pronoun structure retain the same lexemes. Bare versus tanwin-bearing رب citations are valid dictionary presentation variants, not a different refrain or lexical identity.
The repeated saying/command lemmas remain قال. Conventional/wasl-alif spelling and citation-final inflection of the divine name do not change its identity.
Correctly split: عَلَا uses EalaA|I|ACT, while تَعَالَى belongs to the corrected FormVI family. The raw Corpus merger must not force these distinct verbs into one lemma.

diagnosticDispositions.category: Death verbs with corrected active voice
diagnosticDispositions.decision: مَاتَ is the correct active dictionary citation. The applied active/passive correction does not require a passive lemma copied from the raw source label.
The actual forms remain distinguished: نَبَتَ, أَسْقَى, آوَى, أَجَارَ and أَرَى. Active and passive instances of أجار correctly share the active dictionary citation.

خَيْرَة/خَيْر identifies the same good-deeds concept under the requested citation/gender policy. زُبُر is the supplied lexical citation, with context clearly explaining divided groups; no competing wrong lexeme is introduced. مُنْزَل and مُنْزِل remain correctly distinct place/passive-type versus active citations.

diagnosticDispositions.category: General source grouping artefacts and fused particles
diagnosticDispositions.decision: None groups contain unrelated pronouns and particles. Prefix inclusion, particle+pronoun fusion, tanwin/citation endings and small-alif spelling differences do not independently establish an incorrect lemma.

limits: This checks lemma identity and consistency, not a new scholarly certification of every grammatical explanation or tafsir claim.
Valid citation, tanwin, gender and fused-form choices were accepted; optional style homogenization was not requested or proposed.
Only this report was written. No chunk, shared library, guide, metadata, Arabic occurrence, occurrence ID, runtime registry or approval record was changed. No external authoring CLI was invoked.
